description: Terraform archetype (platform, terraform-provider-prefect). Groups provider and module bumps separately.

postUpgradeTasks.description: Regenerate terraform-docs module READMEs after a bump so the terraform-docs pre-commit check does not fail in CI. Guarded on .terraform-docs.yaml so repos without that hook (e.g. platform, terraform-provider-prefect which generate docs differently) no-op. The runner's RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS must permit terraform-docs; the entrypoint installs the binary.
